function swap(is_on,sender)
	n=sender.name
	n1=n:sub(4,4)
	n2=n:sub(5,5)
	o1=no["oxyd" .. n1]
	o2=no["oxyd" .. n2]
	o1.oxydcolor, o2.oxydcolor = o2.oxydcolor, o1.oxydcolor
	o1:peepall()
	sender:kill()
end

function objtonums(l)
	l1={}
	for i=1,5 do
		if l[i].oxydcolor==OXYD_BLUE then
			l1[i]=1
		elseif l[i].oxydcolor==OXYD_RED then
			l1[i]=2
		elseif l[i].oxydcolor==OXYD_GREEN then
			l1[i]=3
		elseif l[i].oxydcolor==OXYD_YELLOW then
			l1[i]=4
		else
			l1[i]=5	
		end
	end
	return l1
end

function pairity(l1)
	l=objtonums(l1)
	counter=0
	for i=2,5 do
		j=i
		while l[j]<l[j-1] and j>1 do
			temp=l[j]
			l[j]=l[j-1]
			l[j-1]=temp
			j=j-1
			counter=counter+1
		end
	end
	return counter%2
end

function is_identity()
	if no["oxyd1"].oxydcolor ~= OXYD_BLUE then
		return false
	end
	if no["oxyd2"].oxydcolor ~= OXYD_RED then
		return false
	end
	if no["oxyd3"].oxydcolor ~= OXYD_GREEN then
		return false
	end
	if no["oxyd4"].oxydcolor ~= OXYD_YELLOW then
		return false
	end
	if no["oxyd5"].oxydcolor ~= OXYD_CYAN then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

if not wo["IsDifficult"] then
	while is_identity() do
		wo:shuffleOxyd()
		if pairity(no["oxyd#*"]) then
			o1=no["oxyd1"]
			o2=no["oxyd2"]
			o1.oxydcolor, o2.oxydcolor = o2.oxydcolor, o1.oxydcolor
		end
	end
end

--end

    "# rx rx rx rx rx r#",
    "##y##y##y##y##y##y#",
    "#O #O #O@#O #O #O #",

    "#O #O #O #O #O #O #",
    "# rx rx rx rx rx r#",
    "###################"})

wo:add(YIN, {"it_spoon"})
wo:add(YIN, {"it_spoon"})

wo:shuffleOxyd()

neighboring_oneways = po(-2,0) .. po(0,-2) .. po(1,0) .. po(0,1)
rooms = no["room#*"]
oneways = no["oneway#*"]
oneways:shuffle()

count_fixations = 0
evil_room = math.random(10, 16)

function fixate(value, sender)
    local room = rooms:nearest(sender)
    if not room["_fixed"] then
        room["_fixed"] = true
        count_fixations = count_fixations + 1
        if (count_fixations == evil_room) and wo["IsDifficult"] then
            st(po(room) + po(-2,0))["_fixorientation"] = EAST
            st(po(room) + po(0,-2))["_fixorientation"] = SOUTH
            st(po(room) + po(1,0))["_fixorientation"] = WEST
            st(po(room) + po(0,1))["_fixorientation"] = NORTH
        end
        st(po(room) + neighboring_oneways)["_fixed"] = true
    end
end

onewaynr = 1

function clock()
    onewaynr = (onewaynr % #oneways) + 1
    local oneway = oneways[onewaynr]
    if oneway["_fixorientation"] then
        if oneway["orientation"] ~= oneway["_fixorientation"] then
            oneway:flip()
        end
    else
        if not(oneway["_fixed"]) then
            oneway:flip()
        end
    end
end
